A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

11-O-debeyzoyltashirone (4), which was isolated from the pericarpos of Illicium species for the first time, has neurotrophic activity, and the structure-neurotrophic activity relationship for seco-prezizane-type sesquitrpenes has been clarified.
seco-prezizane-type sesquiteterpenes, especially those possessing a 7, 14-ortholatone moiety, have a potential to be a lead compound for the development of neurotrophic drugs.
the neurotrophic activity is not due to the cycloparvifo- ralone-type sesquiterepenes (1 and 2) or tashironin, but to the 3 alpha-hy- droxylated 11-O-debencoyltashironins (3 and 4).
The main takeaway from our work is that
seco-prezizane-type sesquiteterpenes are the first class of sesquiterpenoids that have neurotrophic activity.
the 11-O-debentzoyltashirone (4) is the first seco-prezizane-type sesqueterpenes with a neurotrophic activity.
the presence of an ortho-lactone moiety in the sesquiterpene structure is important for the neurotrophic activity.
